CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE public.sp_dwh_aa_dim_teams()
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
DECLARE
    row_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- Truncate the staging table
    TRUNCATE TABLE public."dwh_aa_dim_teams";

    -- Insert data from MRR table
    INSERT INTO public."dwh_aa_dim_teams" (
		team_code,
		team_number,
		team_name,
		team_achievement_score,
		society_id
    )

	SELECT  
		team_code,
		team_number,
		team_name,
		team_achievement_score,
		society_id

	FROM stg_aa_dim_teams

	;

    -- Get the number of rows inserted
    GET DIAGNOSTICS row_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- Log the number of rows loaded
    RAISE NOTICE 'Processed % rows into dwh_aa_dim_teams', row_count;
END;
$procedure$

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE public.sp_stg_aa_dim_teams()
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
DECLARE
    row_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- Truncate the staging table
    TRUNCATE TABLE public."stg_aa_dim_teams";

    -- Insert data from MRR table
    INSERT INTO public."stg_aa_dim_teams" (
		team_code,
		team_number,
		team_name,
		team_achievement_score,
		society_id
    )

	SELECT  
	t.team_code,
	t.team_number,
	t.team_name,
	COALESCE(NULLIF(t.team_achievement_score::text, 'NaN')::float, 0) as team_achievement_score,
	t.society_id

	FROM mrr_aa_new_teams t
		left join mrr_aa_new_supportrequests r on t.support_request_code = r.support_request_code
	WHERE r.support_request_code is not null 

	;

    -- Get the number of rows inserted
    GET DIAGNOSTICS row_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- Log the number of rows loaded
    RAISE NOTICE 'Processed % rows into stg_aa_dim_teams', row_count;
END;
$procedure$
